channel.title: Eastern Daily Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Eastern Daily Press (edp24.co.uk)

item.title: Norwich dad still recovering from life-threatening illness taking on marathon
item.description: Tait Pollack, the CEO of Pivotal, a marketing agency in Red Lion Street, is taking on the London Marathon despite having permanent damage from blood clots.

item.title: Hunt for knife wielding suspect ends
item.description: Detectives hunting a suspect who threatened someone with a knife on the outskirts of the city say their leads have dried up.

item.title: Town council's priorities revealed as tax increases by 20pc
item.description: Bungay Town Council has announced its budget for 2026-27, with a council tax increase of almost 20pc.

item.title: Porter calls time on decades of service with hospital
item.description: A long-serving porter at a Norfolk hospital has retired after clocking up decades of service – and thousands of miles.

item.title: Banksy’s Spraycation: How summer of street art put Norfolk and Suffolk on global map
item.description: In the summer of 2021, as Britain cautiously emerged from lockdown, the elusive street artist Banksy embarked on what he playfully called his "Great British Spraycation."

item.title: Village pub on edge of Norfolk broads set to reopen under a new landlord
item.description: The Horse and Groom in Tunstead, a village on the edge of the Norfolk Broads, is set to open its doors once again as a bid for a new licence has emerged.

item.title: Redundant staff offered food parcels after charity suddenly folds
item.description: Food parcels and energy vouchers have been provided to people affected by the closure of a Suffolk and Norfolk charity as they continue to receive vital support from a council and various agencies.

item.title: Mums must stop treating their sons like little princes
item.description: Mothers of sons need to take urgent action to stop mollycoddling their little princes because they are turning them into trad men who want subservient women.

item.title: Bid for new church car park in quaint Norfolk village to 'improve safety'
item.description: Plans have been submitted for a small parking area by All Saints Church in Thornage, near Holt, to North Norfolk District Council.

item.title: New pool closure rules at four Norfolk holiday park leave guests 'baffled'
item.description: Haven will not be opening their swimming pools on Mondays and Fridays during term time.
